[D1] (8:40-8:54) TS377172: This `Effect.useSpan` callback never uses the span it receives. `Effect.useSpan` does not make that span the parent of spans created inside the callback, so they will not nest under it; `Effect.withSpan` does, and removes `ParentSpan` from the requirements. effect(useSpanUnusedSpanToWithSpan)
  Fix 0: "Disable useSpanUnusedSpanToWithSpan for this line"
  Fix 1: "Disable useSpanUnusedSpanToWithSpan for entire file"

--- file:///.src/useSpanUnusedSpanToWithSpan_preview.ts ---
// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics useSpanUnusedSpanToWithSpan:warning
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const fetchUser: (id: string) => Effect.Effect<{ name: string }>

export const getUser = (id: string) => fetchUser(id).pipe(Effect.withSpan("fetch-user"))
